head.title: SQL Island - English
head.teaser: The english version of the classic game "SQL Island" adapted to work in Eskuel Suite.

text-scene.text: After the survived plane crash, you will be stuck on SQL Island for the time being. By making progress in the game, you will find a way to escape from this island.
The field below is where you write your commands. The complete game will be controlled by means of the database language SQL.
You don't know anything about SQL commands yet? No problem. You will find out all about them here! The output of the SQL Statements will be in the window on the right.
Sometimes there will already be a SQL command in the input field, this is meant to teach you new concepts. Just execute it and see what happens!

Below the Input field you find all tables which you can access: village, inhabitant and item. Each of these tables include several columns (in brackets). You will require this information throughout the entire game!

select-scene.text: "Oh dear, what happened? It seems that I am the only survivor of the air crash. Wow, there are some villages on this island."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM village

select-scene.text: It seems there are a few people living in these villages. How can I see a list of all inhabitants?
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant

text-scene.text: "Woah, so many people!"

select-scene.text: "Man! I'm hungry. I will go and find a butcher to ask for some free sausages."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE job = 'butcher'

text-scene.text: Edward the butcher: "There you are! Enjoy your meal! But take care of yourself. As long as you are unarmed, stay away from villains. Not everyone on this island is friendly."

select-scene.text: "Thank you, Edward! Okay, let's see who is friendly on this island..."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE state = 'friendly'

select-scene.text: "There is no way around getting a sword for myself. I will now try to find a friendly weaponsmith to forge me one. (Hint: You can combine predicates in the WHERE clause with AND)"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE state = 'friendly' AND job = 'weaponsmith'

select-scene.text: "Oh, that does not look good. Maybe other friendly smiths can help you out, e.g. a blacksmith." Try out: job LIKE '%smith' to find all inhabitants whose job ends with 'smith' (% is a wildcard for any number of characters).
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE state = 'friendly' AND job LIKE '%smith'

text-scene.text: "That looks better! I will go and visit those smiths."

manipulate-scene.text: Paul the mayor: "Hi stranger! Where are you going? I'm Paul, I'm the major of Monkeycity. I will go ahead and register you as a citizen."
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: INSERT INTO inhabitant (name, villageid, gender, job, gold, state) VALUES ('Stranger', 1, '?', '?', 0, '?')
manipulate-scene.sql-placeholder: INSERT INTO inhabitant (name, villageid, gender, job, gold, state) VALUES ('Stranger', 1, '?', '?', 0, '?')

select-scene.text: "No need to call me stranger! What's my personid?" (Hint: Use a SELECT query without an asterisk. In former queries, the * stands for: all columns. Instead of the star, you can also address one or more columns (seperated by a comma) and you will only get the columns you need.)
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT personid FROM inhabitant WHERE name = 'Stranger'

text-scene.text: "Hi Ernest! How much is a sword?"

select-scene.text: Ernest the weaponsmith: "I can offer to make you a sword for 150 gold. That's the cheapest you will find! How much gold do you have?"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT gold FROM inhabitant WHERE personid = 20

select-scene.text: "Damn! No mon, no fun. There has to be another option to earn gold other than going to work. Maybe I could collect ownerless items and sell them! Can I make a list of all items that don't belong to anyone?" (Hint: You can recognize ownerless items by: WHERE owner IS NULL)
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM item WHERE owner IS NULL

text-scene.text: "So much cool stuff!"

manipulate-scene.text: "Yay, a coffee cup. Let's collect it!"
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE item SET owner = 20 WHERE item = 'coffee cup'
manipulate-scene.sql-placeholder: UPDATE item SET owner = 20 WHERE item = 'coffee cup'

manipulate-scene.text: "Do you know a trick how to collect all the ownerless items?"
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE item SET owner = 20 WHERE owner IS NULL

select-scene.text: "Now list all of the items I have!"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM item WHERE owner = 20

select-scene.text: "Find a friendly inhabitant who is either a dealer or a merchant. Maybe they want to buy some of my items." (Hint: When you use both AND and OR, don't forget to put brackets correctly!)
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE state = 'friendly' AND (job = 'dealer' OR job = 'merchant')

manipulate-scene.text: Helen the dealer: "I'd like to get the ring and the teapot. The rest is nothing but scrap. Please give me the two items. My personid is 15."
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE item SET owner = 15 WHERE item = 'ring' OR item = 'teapot'

manipulate-scene.text: Helen the dealer: "Thank you. Here, some gold!"
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE inhabitant SET gold = gold + 120 WHERE personid = 20
manipulate-scene.sql-placeholder: UPDATE inhabitant SET gold = gold + 120 WHERE personid = 20

manipulate-scene.text: "Unfortunately, that's not enough gold to buy a sword. Seems like I do have to work after all. Maybe it's not a bad idea to change my name from Stranger to my real name before I will apply for a job."
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT personid, villageid, gender, job, gold, state FROM inhabitant

select-scene.text: "Since baking is one of my hobbies, why not find a baker who I can work for?" (Hint: List all bakers and use 'ORDER BY gold' to sort the results. 'ORDER BY gold DESC' is even better because then the richest baker is on top.)
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE job = 'baker' ORDER BY gold DESC

text-scene.text: "Aha, Paul! I know him!"
Paul the baker: "Hi, you again! I saw you want to work as a baker? Okay! You will be paid 1 gold for 100 bread rolls."

manipulate-scene.text: (8 hours later...) "Here, I made ten thousand bread rolls! I quit! This should be enough money to buy a sword. Let's see what happens with my gold balance."
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE inhabitant SET gold = gold + 100 - 150 WHERE personid = 20
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT personid, villageid, job, gold, state FROM inhabitant
manipulate-scene.sql-placeholder: UPDATE inhabitant SET gold = gold + 100 - 150 WHERE personid = 20

manipulate-scene.text: Ernest the weaponsmith: "Here's your new sword! Now you can go everywhere."

text-scene.text: "Thanks!"

select-scene.text: "Is there a pilot on this island by any chance? He could fly me home."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT * FROM inhabitant WHERE job = 'pilot'

text-scene.text: "Oh no, his state is 'kidnapped'."

select-scene.text: Ernest the weaponsmith: "Horrible, the pilot is held captive by Dirty Dieter! I will show you a trick how to find out the name of the village where Dirty Dieter lives."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT village.name FROM village, inhabitant WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND inhabitant.name = 'Dirty Dieter'
select-scene.sql-placeholder: SELECT village.name FROM village, inhabitant WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND inhabitant.name = 'Dirty Dieter'

text-scene.text: Ernest the weaponsmith: "The expression presented here is called a join. It combines the information of the inhabitant table with information of the village table by matching villageid values."

select-scene.text: "Thanks for the hint! I can use the join to find out the chief's name of the village Onionville." (Hint: In the column 'chief' in the village table, the personid of the chief is stored)
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT inhabitant.name FROM village, inhabitant WHERE village.chief = inhabitant.personid AND village.name = 'Onionville'

text-scene.text: "I've got it! I will visit Fred and ask him about Dirty Dieter and the pilot."

select-scene.text: "Um, how many inhabitants does Onionville have?"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND village.name = 'Onionville'
select-scene.sql-placeholder: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND village.name = 'Onionville'

select-scene.text: Fred the mayor: "Hello, the pilot is held captive by Dirty Dieter in his sister's house. Shall I tell you how many women there are in Onionville? Nah, you can figure it out by yourself!" (Hint: Women show up as gender = 'f')
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND village.name = 'Onionville' AND inhabitant.gender = 'f'

select-scene.text: "Oh, only one woman. What's her name?"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT inhabitant.name FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND village.name = 'Onionville' AND inhabitant.gender = 'f'

text-scene.text: "Let's go!"

select-scene.text: Dirty Dieter: "If you hand me over the entire property of our nearby village Cucumbertown, I will release the pilot. I will show you now what this property consists of."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT SUM(inhabitant.gold) FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND village.name = 'Cucumbertown'
select-scene.sql-placeholder: SELECT SUM(inhabitant.gold) FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND village.name = 'Cucumbertown'

select-scene.text: "Oh no, baking bread alone can't solve my problems. If I continue working and selling items though, I could earn more gold than the worth of gold inventories of all bakers, dealers and merchants together. How much gold is that?"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT SUM(inhabitant.gold) FROM inhabitant, village WHERE village.villageid = inhabitant.villageid AND (inhabitant.job = 'baker' OR inhabitant.job = 'dealer' OR inhabitant.job = 'merchant')

select-scene.text: "Let's have a look at how much average gold people own, depending on their job."
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT job, SUM(inhabitant.gold), AVG(inhabitant.gold) FROM inhabitant GROUP BY job ORDER BY AVG(inhabitant.gold)
select-scene.sql-placeholder: SELECT job, SUM(inhabitant.gold), AVG(inhabitant.gold) FROM inhabitant GROUP BY job ORDER BY AVG(inhabitant.gold)

select-scene.text: "Very interesting: For some reason, butchers own the most gold. How much gold do different inhabitants have on average, depending on their state (friendly, ...)?"
select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT state, AVG(inhabitant.gold) FROM inhabitant GROUP BY state ORDER BY AVG(inhabitant.gold)

text-scene.text: "Ok, so the only way is to mug the villains."

manipulate-scene.text: "Or I might as well go ahead and just kill Dirty Dieter with my sword!"
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: DELETE FROM inhabitant WHERE name = 'Dirty Dieter'
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT personid, villageid job, gold, state FROM inhabitant
manipulate-scene.sql-placeholder: DELETE FROM inhabitant WHERE name = 'Dirty Dieter'

manipulate-scene.text: Dirty Diane: "Heeeey! Now I'm very angry! What will you do next?"
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: DELETE FROM inhabitant WHERE name = 'Dirty Diane'
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT personid, villageid job, gold, state FROM inhabitant

manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE inhabitant SET state = 'friendly' WHERE job = 'pilot'
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT personid, villageid job, gold, state FROM inhabitant

text-scene.text: Arthur the pilot: "Thank's for releasing me! I will fly you home!"

manipulate-scene.text: "I take my sword, some gold and lots of useless items with me as a souvenir. What a big adventure!"
manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE inhabitant SET state = 'emigrated' WHERE personid = 20
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT personid, villageid job, gold, state FROM inhabitant
manipulate-scene.sql-placeholder: UPDATE inhabitant SET state = 'emigrated' WHERE personid = 20

text-scene.text: The game is over. We hope you enjoyed it!
